label: From specification to Verilog
subgoals: Write the specification with interfaces and conventions stated
Sample several candidate modules from the model
Send every candidate to an independent checker

label: Grounding in tools
subgoals: Feed compiler errors back for syntax repair
Check function with a testbench or equivalence check
Synthesize the module and compare its PPA

label: Where generated RTL fails
subgoals: Lint for blocking assignments in sequential logic and inferred latches
Test across the parameter values that will be used
Require a human code review before merging generated RTL
